gene_or_markers: 148 candidate core proteins reduced to 85 high-presence single-copy candidates and then to a 20-gene VBCG set; 16S rRNA comparator
conservation_scope: across the bacterial domain
conservation_basis: The 20 VBCG proteins were selected from broadly sampled bacterial candidates for high presence and single-copy occurrence and used as a core species-tree panel.
dataset_scale: 5506 representatives analyzed in 50 groups of approximately 110 taxa for the reported fidelity tests
msa_parameters: Options not reported; terminal gaps were removed before conserved-block filtering
tree_method: FastTree 2.1.10; LG+Gamma for protein trees and GTR+Gamma for 16S trees; 100 bootstraps
evidence_location: Implementation: Fidelity test for the candidate core genes; Comparison of multiple gene sets in fidelity
curator_note: Conventional per-gene MSA and concatenation, not pseudoalignment. Methods initially says 100 groups, whereas Results, the workflow and fidelity analyses report 50 groups; preserve this reporting inconsistency rather than silently resolving it.

title: Seamless, rapid, and accurate analyses of outbreak genomic data using split k-mer analysis
taxon_scope: 240 Streptococcus pneumoniae PMEN1 genomes
gene_or_markers: Reference-ordered genome-wide SNP pseudoalignment for recombination analysis
conservation_scope: within the closely related Streptococcus pneumoniae PMEN1 lineage
conservation_basis: The input is a reference-ordered genome-wide SNP pseudoalignment rather than a homologous gene or marker panel, so gene-family conservation is not meaningful.
dataset_scale: 240 assemblies mapped against the Spn23F reference
msa_tool: SKA2 ska build plus ska map
msa_parameters: k=17 and k=63; ska map against Spn23F; repeats and ambiguous bases masked
trimming_parameters: --filter-percentage 100.0; otherwise defaults; no outgroup; RAxML tree builder; five iterations
tree_method: RAxML as the Gubbins internal tree builder; RAxML version not reported
evidence_location: Methods: Recombination analysis; Results: SKA2 map can be used to effectively detect recombination
curator_note: Explicit reference-mapped pseudoalignment, not conventional MSA. Coordinate order is required for local SNP-density-based recombination inference; Gubbins masking is conceptually separate from gap/conservation trimming.

title: Analysis of nearly 3000 archaeal genomes from terrestrial geothermal springs sheds light on interconnected biogeochemical processes
taxon_scope: 603 representative archaeal MAGs from terrestrial geothermal springs plus HydDB references
conservation_scope: within each [Fe], [FeFe] or [NiFe] hydrogenase class across geothermal Archaea and archaeal references
conservation_basis: Hydrogenase enzyme homologues were sampled across many archaeal lineages but were not treated as universal single-copy species markers; the three enzyme classes should not be conflated as one ortholog set.
dataset_scale: Hydrogenases identified across 603 rMAGs; final sequence count not stated
tree_method: IQ-TREE version not restated; VT+F+R9; 1000 ultrafast bootstrap iterations
evidence_location: Methods: Phylogenetic tree reconstruction of hydrogenase
curator_note: Conventional single-protein-family MSA, not pseudoalignment. The exact trimAl flags are reported, but the hydrogenase subsection does not restate the trimAl or IQ-TREE versions; do not borrow versions from the separate species-tree workflow.

title: Phylogenomics of Asgard archaea reveals a unique blend of prokaryotic-like horizontal transfer and eukaryotic-like gene duplication
taxon_scope: 60 Asgard archaea and Thermoproteota representatives; 10 seed genomes per phylum
gene_or_markers: Protein families retrieved for every seed gene; top 150 homologues with E-value <1e-5 and continuous overlap >50%
conservation_scope: across Asgard archaea and Thermoproteota proteomes
conservation_basis: The phylomes start from every seed-genome protein and therefore combine housekeeping, broadly distributed and restricted protein families rather than selecting a uniform conserved-marker set.
msa_parameters: Each of three aligners run forward and reverse; six alignments combined with M-Coffee
tree_method: IQ-TREE 1.6.9; best model by BIC; 1000 ultrafast bootstrap replicates
evidence_location: Methods: Genome dynamics across Asgard archaea
curator_note: Conventional protein MSA ensemble, not pseudoalignment. This is the species-overlap phylome workflow; the paper's separate reconciliation pipeline uses updated aligner versions and Mergealign 3 and should not be conflated with this row.

title: Double-stranded RNA sequencing reveals distinct riboviruses associated with thermoacidophilic bacteria from hot springs in Japan
taxon_scope: HsRV-like riboviruses from thermoacidophilic bacterial communities and homologues from moderate aquatic environments
conservation_scope: within the HsRV-like environmental ribovirus lineage across hot-spring and moderate aquatic habitats
conservation_basis: The study explicitly treats these RdRPs as highly divergent members of a newly resolved viral lineage; they are not a broadly retained cellular core marker.
dataset_scale: HsRV-like RdRP homologues; final trimmed alignment contained 520 amino-acid positions; sequence count not stated
tree_method: IQ-TREE 2.0.6; ModelFinder selected LG+I+G4; 1000 SH-aLRT replicates
curator_note: Conventional structure-informed MSA for very remote viral homologues, not pseudoalignment. This workflow differs from the paper's Partitiviridae RdRP analysis, which used MAFFT G-INS-1 and trimAl gap threshold 0.2.

title: AliFilter: a machine learning approach to alignment filtering
taxon_scope: Cyanobacteria phylogenomic evaluation; broader training and tests included bacteria, archaea, viruses, animals and rRNA
conservation_scope: across a Cyanobacteria phylogenomic test plus heterogeneous cross-domain benchmark datasets
conservation_basis: This is an alignment-filtering benchmark over many unrelated loci and data types, so a single biological conservation class for the whole workflow would be misleading.
dataset_scale: 139 loci for the Cyanobacteria tree; 451 alignments across eight primary development datasets
trimming_method: AliFilter compared with BMGE, trimAl, Gblocks, Noisy and ClipKIT
trimming_version: AliFilter not reported; BMGE 2.0; trimAl 1.4.1; Gblocks 0.91b; Noisy 1.5.12; ClipKIT 1.4.1
trimming_parameters: AliFilter default model trained on Dataset 9; BMGE defaults; trimAl automated1; Gblocks b1=b2=0.5n b3=1 b4=6 b5=h; Noisy defaults; ClipKIT defaults
tree_method: IQ-TREE 2.3.6; Q.pfam_gb+C20+R7; 1000 ultrafast bootstraps; three replicate analyses per filtering strategy
evidence_location: Methods: Sequence alignment, filtering, and phylogenetic analyses; Results: Cyanobacteria filtering comparison
curator_note: Explicit trimming-sensitivity benchmark on conventional MSAs. In the Cyanobacteria dataset AliFilter, ClipKIT and unfiltered alignments gave identical topologies, whereas BMGE, trimAl and Gblocks differed; treat this as dataset-specific evidence, not a universal ranking.

title: Stepwise emergence of the neuronal gene expression program in early animal evolution
taxon_scope: 37 metazoans spanning early-branching animals and bilaterians
gene_or_markers: Selected gene families, including transcription-factor families
conservation_scope: across Metazoa from early-branching animals to bilaterians
conservation_basis: The workflow analyzes multiple selected neuronal and transcription-factor families separately, with distinct presence and copy histories rather than one uniformly conserved marker class.
dataset_scale: One tree per selected family; homologues sampled from 37 metazoan proteomes
tree_method: IQ-TREE 2.1.0; ModelFinder restricted to LG,WAG,JTT; up to 10000 iterations; convergence 0.999 for 200 generations; UFBoot 1000
evidence_location: STAR Methods: Gene family-specific phylogenetic analyses
curator_note: TreeShrink 1.3.3 outlier detection was followed by realignment and rebuilding; all relevant parameters were stated.

title: Multiple parallel origins of parasitic Marine Alveolates
taxon_scope: Dinoflagellates, marine alveolates and related alveolates
conservation_scope: across deep alveolate lineages including marine alveolates and dinoflagellates
conservation_basis: Candidate conserved proteins with broad taxon occupancy were paralogue-screened and concatenated for a deep species phylogeny.
tree_method: Single-protein RAxML 8.1.6, LG+G4, 100 rapid bootstraps; concatenated IQ-TREE 1.6.5, LG+C60+F+G4, 1000 UFBoot
evidence_location: Methods: Phylogenomic dataset preparation and analysis
curator_note: Manual screening removed paralogues, prey and contaminants; proteins present in at least 60% of taxa were retained before concatenation.

title: Phylogenomics Resolve the Systematics and Biogeography of the Ant Tribe Myrmicini and Tribal Relationships within the Hyperdiverse Ant Subfamily Myrmicinae
taxon_scope: 62 ant samples; Myrmicini ingroup plus Myrmicinae outgroups
conservation_scope: across Myrmicini and broader Myrmicinae ants
conservation_basis: The dataset consists of targeted ultraconserved elements recovered across the named ant clade and filtered for high taxon completeness.
dataset_scale: 2177 UCE loci; 2.8 Mb; minimum 85% taxon completeness
trimming_method: Gblocks via PHYLUCE; SPRUCEUP outlier filtering
trimming_parameters: Gblocks b1 0.5, b2 0.5, b3 12, b4 7; SPRUCEUP overall lognormal cutoff 0.97 plus stated sample cutoffs 0.08-0.09
tree_method: IQ-TREE2 2.1.1; SWSC-EN partitions; -m MFP+MERGE; -mrate E,I,G; -rclusterf 10; -bb 1000; ASTRAL-III 5.7.4 locus-tree summary
evidence_location: Materials and Methods: Dataset construction: Myrmicini UCEs; Phylogenetic inference
curator_note: MAFFT point version and SPRUCEUP version were not reported, so MSA and overall cleaning are partial despite exact options.

title: The First Three Mitochondrial Genomes for the Characterization of the Genus Egeirotrioza (Hemiptera: Triozidae) and Phylogenetic Implications
taxon_scope: 13 Triozidae ingroup taxa plus 3 psyllid outgroups
gene_or_markers: 13 mitochondrial PCGs and 2 rRNAs; five amino-acid, nucleotide and codon-position matrices
conservation_scope: across Triozidae with nearby psyllid outgroups
conservation_basis: Shared mitochondrial protein-coding genes and rRNAs are organellar phylogenetic markers sampled within a named insect clade.
tree_method: IQ-TREE 2 with ModelFinder; PMSF mtART+C60+FO+R for the amino-acid matrix; PhyloBayes-MPI CAT+GTR
curator_note: SH-aLRT and UFBoot2 support types are shown, but replicate counts are not reported; do not infer them.

title: Multiple Horizontal Transfers of Immune Genes Between Distantly Related Teleost Fishes
taxon_scope: 242 annotated ray-finned fish species
gene_or_markers: 3584 BUSCO proteins present in at least 121 species
conservation_scope: across ray-finned fishes
conservation_basis: BUSCO proteins are conserved single-copy ortholog markers used here in a large multispecies species-tree analysis; the paper's occupancy criterion does not establish sequence identity or rate.
tree_method: IQ-TREE2, version not reported; ModelFinder; 1000 UFBoot; collapse nodes below 10%; ASTRAL-III, version not reported, species tree
curator_note: Do not treat cited software papers as executed versions; MUSCLE point version is reported, but alignment options and trimAl, IQ-TREE2 and ASTRAL point versions are not.

title: Single-cell transcriptomics reveals lateral transfers of multiple functional genes from prokaryotes to free-living ciliated protists in detrital food webs
taxon_scope: Metopus yantaiensis and 36 anaerobic ciliate omics datasets plus broad eukaryotic, bacterial, archaeal and viral homologues
gene_or_markers: 63 phylogenetically confirmed prokaryote- or virus-derived LGT protein families
conservation_scope: across anaerobic ciliates with eukaryotic, bacterial, archaeal and viral homologues
conservation_basis: The 63 families were selected specifically as prokaryote- or virus-derived lateral-transfer candidates, implying patchy cross-domain histories rather than core-marker retention.
dataset_scale: Approximately 200-500 sequences per candidate after CD-HIT; retained alignments longer than 80 aa with more than 30 references
msa_parameters: Output ordered by alignment quality; alignment mode and options not reported
tree_method: IQ-TREE 1.4.4; ModelFinder Plus BIC among LG+C60, LG+C20 and LG4X; UFBoot 1000; SH-aLRT 1000
evidence_location: Methods: Phylogenetic analyses and phylogenetic tree interpretation
curator_note: The paper reports MAFFT only as version 7 and gives no alignment mode; no CLI syntax was inferred.

title: Chimeric origins and dynamic evolution of central carbon metabolism in eukaryotes
taxon_scope: 207 representative eukaryotes with broad prokaryotic and viral homologues
conservation_scope: across representative eukaryotes with broad prokaryotic and viral homologues
conservation_basis: Central-carbon-metabolism enzyme homologues were reconstructed as individual broadly sampled protein-family trees, not as a universal single-copy marker panel.
dataset_scale: Refined enzyme-family trees from a 207-eukaryote core plus expanded prokaryotic and viral homologues
tree_method: IQ-TREE 2.1.2; -mset LG or -m LG+C20+G+F; -bb 1000 -bnni -alrt -nstop 500 -pers 0.2
evidence_location: Methods: Phylogenetic analyses: CCM enzyme phylogenies
curator_note: Both strict MSA coverage above 80% and inclusive coverage above 20% datasets were used; the -alrt replicate count is not stated in this subsection.

title: Identification of a deep-branching lineage of algae using environmental plastid genomes
taxon_scope: 660 environmental plastid MAGs plus 166 plastid and 13 cyanobacterial references
conservation_scope: across plastid-bearing eukaryotic lineages with cyanobacterial references
conservation_basis: The 93 plastid-encoded proteins form an organellar marker supermatrix used to resolve deep plastid relationships.
dataset_scale: 839 taxa; 93 genes; 19242 amino-acid sites; reduced 107-taxon matrix with 20292 sites
msa_version: version not reported for final concatenated alignment
msa_parameters: G-INS-i; --unalign 0.6; preceded by Prequal 1.02 with posterior threshold 0.95
tree_method: IQ-TREE 2.2.2.6; 839-taxon LG+F+I+G4 with 1000 UFBoot; 107-taxon cpREV+C60+G4 and MEOW plus Bayesian sensitivity analyses
evidence_location: Methods: Phylogenomic plastid dataset assembly; Phylogenomic analyses of plastid datasets
curator_note: Do not carry MAFFT 7.407 from the earlier 179-reference curation into the final supermatrix because the final-alignment subsection does not restate it.

title: Improved gene tree inference from removing alignment errors both from focal genes and when training substitution models
taxon_scope: 190 mammal species spanning seven OrthoMaM taxonomic groups
gene_or_markers: 6769 curated single-copy mammalian ortholog protein families
conservation_scope: across 190 mammal species in an alignment-error benchmark
conservation_basis: Although the inputs are curated single-copy mammalian orthologs, the workflow benchmarks alignment filtering across thousands of unrelated loci rather than assigning a biological conservation class to one gene family.
dataset_scale: 6769 loci from OrthoMaM v12; 1000 used for substitution-model training and 5769 for gene-tree testing
msa_version: Point version not restated for the OrthoMaM workflow
msa_parameters: -stratified generates 16 alternative alignments by perturbing HMMs and guide trees
trimming_parameters: Retain an amino-acid pairing only when present in all 16 alternative alignments; split consensus subgroups into columns; discard singleton columns
tree_method: IQ-TREE2, version not reported; ModelFinder selected rate heterogeneity; 1000 UFBoot replicates per gene tree
evidence_location: Materials and methods: CLOAK; Mammalian orthologs; Comparison of gene trees to species trees; Gene tree precision
curator_note: The paper found gentle focal-gene filtering and stricter substitution-model-training filtering useful for different tasks; this is a task-specific benchmark, not a universal recommendation to replace established filters.

title: Deep origin of eukaryotes outside Heimdallarchaeia within Asgardarchaeota
taxon_scope: 411 Asgard archaea with DPANN, Euryarchaea, TACK and selected eukaryotic or other outgroups depending on marker set
gene_or_markers: Twelve published marker sets plus newly constructed S67, S97 and S150 protein marker sets
conservation_scope: across Asgardarchaeota and other major archaeal lineages, with selected eukaryotic outgroups
conservation_basis: Published archaeal marker panels and the new S67, S97 and S150 sets were assembled and paralogue-checked specifically for deep archaeal phylogenomics.
dataset_scale: Multiple supermatrices; examples include 579 archaeal taxa for GTDB.ar53 and 425 taxa for S150
tree_method: IQ-TREE 2.2.2.6; LG+C60+F+G+PMSF; -B 1000; additional site-exclusion and Bayesian sensitivity analyses
evidence_location: Methods: Phylogenomic analyses using public marker sets; Construction and phylogenomic analyses of new marker sets
curator_note: Exact deep-archaeal protein-supermatrix workflow; the paper separately checked individual-marker paralogy and tested taxon, site-rate and recoding sensitivity, which column filtering alone cannot replace.

title: Early hexapod genomes reveal the deep origin of insect gustatory and odorant receptors
taxon_scope: Early-divergent hexapods and insects with centipede gustatory receptors as outgroup
gene_or_markers: Gustatory and odorant receptor protein families
conservation_scope: across early-divergent hexapods and insects with centipede receptor outgroups
conservation_basis: Gustatory and odorant receptors are analyzed as insertion-rich homologous receptor families rather than single-copy core markers; the factorial design tests alignment and trimming sensitivity.
dataset_scale: Sixteen analyses: two aligners by four column treatments by with or without PMSF
tree_method: IQ-TREE 2.0.7 with ModelFinder and UFBoot2; JTT+F+R10; PMSF sensitivity under LG+C60+G+F; UFBoot replicate count not reported
curator_note: Direct aligner-by-filter factorial design for insertion-rich receptors. The article equates -gt 0.75 with removing columns having at least 75% gaps, but official trimAl documentation defines -gt as 1 minus the gap fraction; preserve the reported argv, flag the semantic conflict, and do not translate the prose into a new command without verification.
